method: Root manual unblinded inspection of every complete immutable endpoint patch, exact public APIs, delivered tests, command chronology and delivery. decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-reference
evidence: Shared normalizer handles nonpositive/NaN separately, positive infinity tolength and finite floor capped atlength; both consumers safely slice length-normalized count and preserve original overloads. New11 tests include oversized10, all invocation styles, fresh/readonly identity and actual generic assertions; all five endpoints pass. Exact final required43/44/45, delivered types46 and original workspace compiler52 pass after the final edit. Guessed task remeda:check47 is rejected and recovered via literal npm workspace command, without altering configuration. No duplicate final required checks, protected/dependency changes or retrieval; accurate coverage. Forwarded metadata joins every request and confirms zero header receipts in this reference arm.

decisions.name: 1-suffix-counts-candidate
evidence: The helper floors finite positive counts but never caps them at input length; both consumers remove original Math.max index clamps and slice at length-count. For length2/count3, takeLast returns only the last element and dropLast retains a prefix instead of all/empty. This violates preserved integer behavior and is the known F53/F58 model-error family. New tests omit oversized finite counts and mirror the same length-count expectation; they pass runtime/types while independent feature oracle fails. Required final47/48/49 and delivered types50 really pass on final source; signatures/dependencies/original checks are unchanged, no retrieval and reported executions truthful. No replace_body call or header exposure occurs, so this adverse outcome cannot be caused by using the body-header receipt. Retain failed unchanged patch and every cost.
